The product is odd only when both spins are odd. The first spinner has two odd labels ($3,5$) among three equal sectors, and the second has two odd labels ($5,7$) among four equal sectors. Since the spins are independent, the probability of an odd product is $(2/3)(2/4)=1/3$. The probability of an even product is therefore $1-1/3=2/3$.
Final answer: \frac{2}{3}
